newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks rise on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks rise on short covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose at Tuesday's opening on short-covering on settlement day, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
The 100-share index rose 0.29 points, or 0.02 percent, to 1,527.21 in the first hour. Losers led gainers 121 to 29.
Short-covering in speculative stocks pushed the index up, dealer Azhar Batla of Taurus Securities said.
Shell Pakistan rose 2.50 rupes to 234 and Pakistan State Oil 2.00 to 302. PTCL was unchanged at 24.85 and HUBCO rose 0.15 to 37.05. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
